001: Good morning! I need to get a second copy of my ID document.
Good morning! Did you schedule your appointment on the website, ma'am?
I haven't scheduled it yet. Can I do that right here?
Yes, you can, but you'll have to wait in line for a little while.
No problem. How long does the wait usually take?
On average, about forty minutes, but today it's calmer.
002: Excuse me, I came to pick up my birth certificate.
Did you bring the request protocol, ma'am?
Yes, I did, it's right here with me. Do you need any other documents?
Just the protocol and a photo ID, please.
Okay. Can I pick up someone else's certificate?
Only if you have a power of attorney signed and notarized at a registry office.
003: Hi, I need to update my address in the system.
Hello! You can do that through the app, ma'am, without having to come here.
The thing is, the app isn't accepting my proof of address.
I see. Then I'll need to see the current proof of address and your ID.
Here are both. The proof of address is in my name, for sure.
Perfect. I'll make the update now, just a moment.
004: Sir, I came to sort out a problem with my benefit.
Do you have the case number or the benefit card, ma'am?
I have the card here. The payment didn't come in this month.
Let me check the system... Here it says there was a block.
A block? Why? I wasn't informed about anything.
It might have been due to a lack of registration update. I'll check with the department in charge.
005: Good morning! I'd like to apply for my retirement.
Good morning! Did you already do the simulation on the social security portal, ma'am?
Yes, I did, but it showed that some documents are missing.
Did you bring the documents that the portal listed, ma'am?
I brought all of them, except for my old work card.
Without that document, the review will take longer. Can you bring it later?
006: Excuse me, I need an income tax statement.
Did you already file this year's tax return, ma'am?
Yes, I did, but I lost the receipt and I need to prove that I filed it.
No problem. I can issue a second copy of the receipt here.
That solves my problem. Is there any fee to pay?
No, this service is free. I'll issue it for you now.
007: Hello! I came to renew my driver's license.
Hello! Did you already take the medical exam and the psychological exam, ma'am?
I took both, but the psychological result hasn't come out yet.
Then you need to wait for the result to come out in the system.
And how long does it take to come out? I'm in a hurry.
In general, up to five business days. You can track it on the website.
008: Miss, I need to file a report for lost documents.
Which documents did you lose, ma'am? All together?
I lost my ID, my CPF, and my bank card.
You can file everything in a single report online.
I'd rather do it right here, to make sure everything is correct.
That's fine. I'll need some personal information and the place where you lost them.
009: Good morning! I came to request an exemption from the exam fee.
Good morning! Which exemption criterion do you fit into, ma'am?
I'm registered in the unified registry for social programs.
Did you bring the updated registration proof, ma'am?
Yes, I did, but it's under my mother's name. I'm a dependent.
In that case, you'll also need to present your birth certificate.
010: Excuse me, I wanted to know if my case has been reviewed yet.
Do you have the protocol number for me to look it up, ma'am?
Yes, I do. The number is right here on this paper.
Let me see... The case is under review in the legal department.
And is there an estimate for when the result will come out?
Unfortunately, we don't have an exact date, but you can track it on the website.
